templates.name: The Patron Invitation
subject_lines: An Invitation from the Pawché Atelier
templates.body:
Dear [Influencer Name],

We have been following the journey of [Dog's Name] with great admiration. There is a rare elegance in your presentation that resonates deeply with the aesthetic we uphold at Pawché.

We are currently curating our 'Patron Circle'—a small collective of refined individuals who share our devotion to the humanization of pet luxury. We would be honored to invite you and [Dog's Name] to experience the Atelier first-hand.

As a Patron, you would receive early access to our seasonal Wardrobe collections and bespoke pieces from The Vault, designed to elevate [Dog's Name]’s presence to its rightful status.

If you feel our worlds align, I would love to discuss a more formal partnership.

Warmly,

[Your Name]
Pawché Concierge

templates.name: The Atelier Spotlight
subject_lines: For [Dog's Name]: A Piece from The Vault
templates.body:
Hello [Influencer Name],

At Pawché, we believe that luxury is not a luxury—it is a standard. We’ve noticed [Dog's Name] has a penchant for the finer things, and we would like to offer a small token from our latest curation.

We would love to send [Dog's Name] one of our signature [Product Name] from The Wardrobe. No obligations, simply a gift from our Atelier to yours. We believe the Obsidian & Gold aesthetic would be a striking match for your upcoming content.

Should you find the piece as exceptional as we do, we would be delighted to see it featured in your world.

Please let us know your preferred shipping address and [Dog's Name]’s measurements.

With high regards,

[Your Name]
Pawché Atelier

templates.name: The Inner Circle
subject_lines: An Exclusive Extension for Your Community
templates.body:
Dear [Influencer Name],

Your community’s dedication to elevated pet lifestyle is truly inspiring. Because of the organic synergy between your brand and the Pawché aesthetic, we would like to invite you into our Inner Circle.

This is an invitation-only affiliate program designed for those who already embody the Pawché lifestyle. By joining, you can provide your followers with a private entry into our world, while being rewarded for your continued patronage.

Members of the Inner Circle receive:
- A bespoke invitation code for your community.
- Commission on every acquisition made through your recommendation.
- Priority access to limited-edition releases from The Vault.

We prefer to keep our circle small and our standards high. We would be thrilled to have you among us.

Are you open to a brief conversation about the details?

Best,

[Your Name]
Pawché Growth Strategist
